passages.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is worthy of praise.
I will thank the LORD.
I will use all my heart to thank Him.
I will thank Him when I am with upright people.
I will thank Him when I am with the assembly.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃

passages.text: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD does great works.
His works are very great.
People who delight in His works think about them.
They study His works carefully.
Everyone who loves His works seeks to understand them.
passages.original: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכָל־ חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD does great works.
His works are splendid.
His works are majestic.
His righteousness lasts forever.
passages.original: הוֹד־ וְהָדָ֥ר פָּֽעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃

passages.text: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is gracious.
The LORD is compassionate.
The LORD has done wonders.
He has made His wonders remembered.
passages.original: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
passages.sermon:
God provides food.
He gives food to those who fear Him.
God remembers His covenant.
He remembers His covenant forever.
passages.original: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
passages.sermon: The LORD is gracious and compassionate.\r\nHe has shown His people the power of His works.\r\nHe gave His people the inheritance of the nations.
passages.original: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
passages.sermon:
God acts with truth and justice.
God’s works show truth.
God’s works show justice.
All God’s commands are trustworthy.
God’s precepts never fail.
passages.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל־ פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃

passages.text: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
passages.sermon:
God’s precepts stand firm forever.
God’s precepts last for all time.
God made His precepts in truth.
God made His precepts in uprightness.
passages.original: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃

passages.text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
passages.sermon:
God sent redemption to His people.
God established His covenant forever.
God’s name is holy.
God’s name is awesome.
passages.original: פְּד֤וּת׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is holy and awesome.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
Wisdom starts when you fear the LORD.
People who follow the LORD’s commands gain good understanding.
His praise lasts forever.
passages.original: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה׀ יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכָל־ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
